title: Blue Green Solutions repeats the Finaps Mendix profile on weaker evidence
content:
The research records Blue Green Solutions as the same shape as Finaps, with weaker evidence. It is a Mendix Expert partner in the Netherlands; the workbook marks its size as not verified and records no client domain.

That is the whole of the finding, and it is worth keeping as it stands rather than padded out. The Mendix cohort in this corpus is ranked on how well a firm's clients and domain match the conversion thesis, and this lead cannot be ranked that way because the supporting facts were never established. It sits behind Finaps for want of evidence, not because a different judgement was reached about it.

Recording the reason keeps the ranking honest and reversible. If the missing detail is verified later, the lead moves on evidence rather than on impression; if it is not, it stays where it is with a stated cause. Either is better than a lead that looks weak without anyone being able to say why.
